notes.title: Update Notes For July 2024 Pt.2
notes.notes:
Some small convenience things:
[list]
[*]Being Idle for 20s in the main menus will trigger an AI vs AI match just for watching. It will use the current game settings
[*]AI looks less robotic. The rods that are further away from the ball wont get updated as frequent as before.
[*]Hard AI to be slightly less hard. Decreased some values that ware just too inhuman.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes For July 2024
notes.notes:
You asked for it, and here it is! ⚽

Introducing the new [i]Steady Rod Modes[/i]! Unlike the 1:1 Control mode, the Steady modes do not snap the rod back to the center when you release the analog stick. This mode is now the default setting when you start the game. Here are the new settings available for each player:
[list]
[*]Steady Slow
[*]Steady Med
[*]Steady Fast
[*]Steady 1:1 Control
[/list]
The default setting is [i]Steady Med[/i] with a sensitivity of 6. [i]Steady Slow[/i] has a sensitivity of 3, and [i]Steady Fast[/i] has a sensitivity of 12. For those who like to customize their experience, these values can be tweaked in the USER/settings_user.xml file. 🤓

notes.title: Update Notes For Jan 19
notes.notes:
[h1]New Feature: AI Opponents[/h1]
- AI has been added to the game
- You can play as Solo or Duo against AI
- Three difficulties which vary in responsiveness and skill
- 4 new achievements to unlock around AI 
- small bug fixes that reduce flickering in the menu
